name: Jean Michel Picod
biography: Jean-Michel Picod is currently working at Google Switzerland. He holds an engineering degree in computer systems, networks and security. He has contributed on several open source projects (GoodFET, pynids, etc.) and published several open source tools such as DPAPIck, OWADE, scapy-radio, forensic scripts, Twitter: @jmichel_p Website: https://www.j-michel.org/
